description:
The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3. A 3D printing technician needs to prepare a skull model but must remove the cervical vertebrae (neck bones) to ensure the model sits flat. 

1. Create a bone segmentation mask using the standard 'Bone' threshold (226 to 3071 HU) or similar.
2. Use the Manual Segmentation / Slice Editor tools to ERASE the mask content completely from the bottom 10 axial slices (Axial Slice 1 through 10).
3. Export the modified mask as a NIfTI file to '/home/ga/Documents/cleaned_skull.nii.gz'.

Ensure the rest of the skull remains segmented. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
